post.description:
Process a delivery-status callback from GeezSMS.

Expected payload fields (all optional — the API may add more)::

    {
        "message_status": "delivered",
        "phone": "251912345678",
        "message": "Your OTP is ...",
        "api_log_id": "abc-123"
    }

Returns ``{"status": "ok"}`` on success so GeezSMS knows we accepted the
event and won't retry.

schema.title: Response Geezsms Delivery Callback Api V1 Sms Geezsms Callback Post
